node.statement: Fix the global package W_RF, then an arbitrary admissible input (H,Phi,eta), a datum S, Delta', Delta, an integer n>=1, and X,Y in M_n(S.B), exactly as in the root prefix. By def-routef-raw-factor-setting, rho_DeltaPhi=min{rho_theta,rho_Delta,rho_2}; hence 0<=eta<=rho_DeltaPhi implies eta<=rho_theta=1/8, eta<=rho_Delta, and eta<=rho_2.
